note: The webhook Seerr sends when a request is approved (MEDIA_APPROVED): what Deluno's webhook route reads to add the title. The request is what Seerr itself sent to the webhook address; the reply is the receiving container plain ok, not an answer from Deluno (Seerr 3.5.0 in Docker, linked to a Jellyfin; titles from TMDb through Seerr's own key).

body.subject: Sintel (2010)
body.message: A wandering warrior finds an unlikely friend in the form of a young dragon. The two develop a close bond, until one day the dragon is snatched away. She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.
